execution.database_mode: one REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY PostgreSQL transaction

public.survey_authority_compendium.note: D05 inventories all columns and row count; it does not guess semantic aliases for this relation.

public.ddm_demographic_field_register.note: All actual columns are inventoried; source-native candidates are emitted when source_family/wave/var_name/question_id/demographic_kind exist.

failure_codes.D05_E_DATABASE_CONNECT: Populated PostgreSQL could not be reached.
failure_codes.D05_E_NOT_READ_ONLY: The transaction is not read-only; abort.
failure_codes.D05_E_REQUIRED_RELATION_MISSING: A fatal core relation is absent.
failure_codes.D05_E_REQUIRED_COLUMN_MISSING: A fatal core column is absent.
failure_codes.D05_E_QUERY_FAILED: A fixed audit query failed; no reinterpretation is permitted.
failure_codes.D05_E_STATIC_PROVENANCE_MISMATCH: Static evidence hash disagrees with locked identity.
failure_codes.D05_E_WRONG_BRANCH: Audit is not being run on the commanded D05 branch.
failure_codes.D05_E_WRONG_BASE: The commanded exact base SHA is not an ancestor of HEAD.
failure_codes.D05_W_RELATION_ABSENT: Expected non-core relation absent; record and continue.
failure_codes.D05_W_COLUMN_ABSENT: Expected non-core column absent; record and continue.
failure_codes.D05_W_TYPED_MISSINGNESS_NOT_EXPOSED: Typed missingness field is not physically exposed by audited long relation.
failure_codes.D05_W_ROUTING_NOT_EXPOSED: Routing/IAP/not-asked authority is not physically exposed.
failure_codes.D05_W_SHARED_CACHE_NOT_MATERIALIZED: No materialized V550 shared respondent substrate was found to compare.
failure_codes.D05_F_DUPLICATE_RESPONDENT_ID: Respondent surrogate IDs are not unique.
failure_codes.D05_F_ORPHAN_RESPONSE: Response row has no respondent parent.
failure_codes.D05_F_OVERLAP_IMPOSSIBLE: Computed pair overlap exceeds a marginal respondent count.
failure_codes.D05_F_JOIN_PARTITION: Join-status buckets do not partition raw response rows exactly.
failure_codes.D05_F_FACET_MULTIPLICITY_LOSS: Facet-ready respondent/question row multiplicity differs from raw response substrate.
failure_codes.D05_F_RAW_CODE_LOSS: Raw response code multiset differs after facet-ready transformation.
failure_codes.D05_F_MULTIPLE_PRIMARY_WEIGHT_SELECTION: More than one primary weight exists for a respondent while facet-ready selects one.

invariants: survey_microdata_respondents.id is non-null and globally unique
every survey_microdata_responses.respondent_id has a respondent parent
all respondent/var duplicate multiplicity is counted, never assumed away
canonical respondent/question duplicate multiplicity is counted separately from raw var multiplicity
for every question pair 0 <= overlap <= min(n_x,n_y)
identity join buckets exactly partition raw response rows
facet-ready parity is tested at source/wave/country/respondent/var multiplicity grain
where value_raw/value_text exist in both surfaces their multisets must be preserved
at most one primary weight may be silently selected per respondent
typed missingness is never inferred from blank/null response values
question topology is never inferred from observed cardinality
scalar weight presence is never treated as design-based inference authority
absence of a position value is measured as substrate missingness, not real-world absence
source-equivalent status cannot be PROVED from DB parity alone when routing/design/source-native artifacts remain unverified
proof_bar: The runner deliberately never returns PROVED_SOURCE_EQUIVALENT from database parity alone. That status requires verified source-native/routing/design evidence in addition to the populated DB audit.
